title: jasione montana subsp. echinata
intro: Jasione montana subsp. echinata, commonly known as the Scottish heather, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Jasione montana subsp. echinata include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
